en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Usman Bin Isa, from Saeed Bin Yassar, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘Iblees<sup>la</sup>, may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse him<sup>la</sup>, disputed with Noah<sup>as</sup> regarding the grapes. So Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> came to him<sup>as</sup> and said: ‘There is a right for him<sup>la</sup>, so give him<sup>la</sup>’. So he<sup>as</sup> gave him the one-third. But Iblees<sup>la</sup> did not agree. Then he<sup>as</sup> gave him<sup>la</sup> the half, but he<sup>la</sup> did not agree. So Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> threw the fire, and two-thirds was incinerated, and there remained the one-third. So he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘Whatever the fire incinerated, so it is his<sup>la</sup> share, and whatever remains, so it is Permissible for you<sup>as</sup>, O Noah<sup>as</sup>!
en.sarwar: 4. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Kufiy from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sa‘id ibn Yasar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,

‘Iblis, may Allah condemned him, disputed with Noah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam about the grape vine and Jibril, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, came and said, ‘He has a right, so give him? He gave him one-third but he did not agree. He gave one-half but he did not agree. Jibril then threw a fire, which burnt two-thirds and one-third was left. He said, ‘Whatever fire has burnt is his share and what has remained, O Noah, is lawful for you?”
